ProviderSettings._comment_Ollama_LineEdit: RepeatPenalty 1.3 breaks the LineEdit repetition loop observed live (Dicta fell into a 335s loop emitting ~10 identical suggestions + 'לא,'->'לא' punctuation noise before the JSON truncated mid-object). The loop is a decoding failure, so a repeat penalty ABOVE the 1.1 ProviderTuningOptions default and the 1.2 LinguisticAnalysis value is the primary fix; the post-parse dedupe/no-op/cap in UnifiedAnalysisService.NormalizeLineEditSuggestions is the structural backstop. Keep NumPredict 5120 and Temperature 0.2 as-is.
ProviderSettings._comment_Ollama_BookReview: Whole-book developmental review (wb2). Each per-dimension call sends the ENTIRE budgeted book context ([BOOK_CONTEXT] = BookBrief + many ChapterBriefs) and the model emits a per-chapter dimensionSignals scratch block BEFORE the findings, so BOTH input and output scale with chapter count. WITHOUT this entry AiTaskType.BookReview falls back to NumCtx=4096 (the implicit ProviderTuningOptions default, NOT the Ollama entry's 8192) — on a 15+ chapter book the input alone overflows 4096, Ollama TRUNCATES the prompt, and the model returns a lone '{' so ExtractJson fails and EVERY dimension returns null (job falsely Succeeded with 0 findings). NumCtx=16384 fits a large book's input+output (book budget derives as NumCtx*0.5≈8192 tokens, matching LinguisticAnalysis); NumPredict=6144 gives the dimensionSignals+findings output room to complete on a 20-40 chapter book. Verified live (gemma4:12b, 16-chapter synthetic): default 4096 -> 1-char '{' (6/6 fail); 16384/6144 -> complete valid JSON, findings parse.
ProviderSettings._comment_Ollama_AnalysisRepair: Value-scoped analysis-output repair (analysis-output-repair plan, p3). AnalysisRepairService sends ONE analysis prose field at a time to gemma4:12b for a Hebrew cleanup (remove leaked English terms/garbles) with structure held by code, so 16384 ctx is ample headroom for a single field + the verbatim repair instruction and NumPredict 2048 fits a repaired field. Low Temperature (0.2) keeps the repair conservative. KEEP IN SYNC with FeatureModels:AnalysisRepair below (both must exist for the repair pass to route to gemma4:12b); the Ai:AnalysisRepair block (Enabled/GuardOnly/PerType) gates whether the pass RUNS, these keys only ROUTE.
ProviderSettings._comment_Ollama_GenericChat: Free-form Custom prompts and QA (AiTaskType.GenericChat) send the WHOLE chapter as input. WITHOUT this entry GenericChat falls back to the base Ollama window (NumCtx=8192); a large chapter (e.g. 23k chars ≈ 15k+ Hebrew tokens) overflows it, Ollama TRUNCATES the prompt, and because the instruction/question sits at the START of the prompt it gets dropped — the model then sees only chapter text with no task and returns a 1-token fragment (observed live: 'סי'). NumCtx=16384 matches LinguisticAnalysis/Summarization and fits a full chapter + the question; NumPredict=2048 is ample for a free-form answer (think=false keeps output short).

FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadModel: KEEP IN SYNC: Proofread:Model is duplicated in ProofreadQualityTests.ProofreadModel (Pagedraft.Api.Tests/LanguageEngine/ProofreadQualityTests.cs). Update both when changing the model.
FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadFallback: DEPLOYMENT RISK: DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B (Proofread) and gemma4:12b (Proofread_en / LinguisticAnalysis) must be pulled on every Ollama host before starting the API. If either model is missing, OllamaProvider's 404-retry-with-default silently falls back to DefaultModel (qwen3.5:9b) with no error surfaced - for Proofread that is the overreaching model this work replaced (precision 13%, known meaning-changing edits). Run: ollama pull hf.co/dicta-il/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct-GGUF:latest && ollama pull gemma4:12b
FeatureModels._comment_ProofreadCloud: CLOUD MAX-QUALITY = OpenRouter / google/gemma-4-31b-it (Hebrew bake-off subset 2026-06-20: precision 88%, recall 100%, overreach 0/2 (precision gate PASS), ~$0.001; see docs/PROOFREAD_LINEEDIT_CLOUD_BAKEOFF.md). A ~31B model that does NOT fit the 8 GB dev GPU - it is the quality ceiling for FUTURE GPU-server hosting, not the local default. Active value is the best LOCAL model (Ollama/DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B) for free/offline/private use. To ship the cloud winner set Provider=OpenRouter, Model=google/gemma-4-31b-it AND update ProofreadQualityTests.ProofreadModel to match; otherwise keep the local model below.
FeatureModels._comment_Proofread_en: English MEASURED 2026-06-21 (proofread-gold-en.json, 30 cases) - gemma4:12b vs qwen3.5:9b: precision 82% vs 31%, recall 69% vs 69% (tied), fp-rate 6% vs 53%, overreach 0/3 vs 1/3, F0.5 0.789 vs 0.349. gemma4:12b validated on the same precision gate as the Hebrew flow - far higher precision/lower overreach at equal recall; cost is ~2.2x latency (4414 vs 2023 ms/case), acceptable for proofread. KEEP gemma4:12b. Cloud gemma-4-31b-it remains the future-GPU upgrade candidate.
FeatureModels._comment_LinguisticAnalysis: CLOUD MAX-QUALITY = OpenRouter / google/gemma-4-31b-it (bake-off 0.900, ~8s/case; see docs/LINGUISTIC_MODEL_BAKEOFF.md). Active value is Ollama/gemma4:12b - the best LOCAL model (0.750, 0 false positives; requires Ollama >= 0.30) for free/offline/private use. To ship the cloud winner set Provider=OpenRouter, Model=google/gemma-4-31b-it; otherwise keep Ollama/gemma4:12b.

CLOUD MAX-QUALITY = OpenRouter / google/gemma-4-31b-it - the ~31B model that does NOT fit the 8 GB dev GPU; it is the structured-review quality ceiling for FUTURE GPU-server hosting, not the local default. Active value is Ollama/gemma4:12b - the strongest LOCAL structured model per the bake-off (same model LinguisticAnalysis uses) for free/offline/private use. To ship the cloud winner set Provider=OpenRouter, Model=google/gemma-4-31b-it; otherwise keep Ollama/gemma4:12b.
FeatureModels._comment_AnalysisRepair: Value-scoped analysis-output repair (analysis-output-repair plan, p3). gemma4:12b is the proven repair model (diagnostic Part 2: removed 100% of seeded English leaks value-only while preserving meaning/structure; Dicta over-rewrote). This is the 'routes to itself' key — there is NO AnalysisType.AnalysisRepair, so AnalysisTaskMapping is untouched; AnalysisRepairService builds its AiRequest with TaskType=AnalysisRepair directly and the router resolves THIS key. KEEP IN SYNC with ProviderSettings:Ollama_AnalysisRepair above. The value-scoped LLM pass ships gated OFF by default (Ai:AnalysisRepair.GuardOnly=true, the p3-gate guard-only decision), so these keys only ROUTE, they do not enable.

Ai._comment_BookReviewSingleCombined: Whole-book review fan-out strategy (wb2-r02). TRUE (default) runs ONE combined LLM call assessing all six dimensions (plot/character/pacing/tone/theme/continuity) over a single assembled book context; FALSE falls back to the per-dimension fan-out (six calls capped by MaxParallelBookReviewDimensions). Default is single-combined because wb2-c04 measured per-dimension (6 calls/book) as a QUALITY TIE with single-combined (1 call/book) - same planted-recall, same 0 clean false positives, identical composite - at 6x the model calls and more noise; wb2-c06 then showed the per-dimension parallel fan-out CRASHES the 8 GB dev GPU on big books while a single combined call completes. Per-dimension is kept reversible behind this toggle ONLY for a future larger-GPU re-measure; set false to use it.
Ai._comment_OllamaParallel: For parallel chunk processing, set env OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2 (or higher) where Ollama runs; restart Ollama after changing.
Ai._comment_HebrewStyle: House-style toggles for the Hebrew copyedit layer. EnforceKtivMale=true (default) appends deterministic haser->male full-spelling suggestions to Hebrew proofread results; set false for houses that do not normalize to ktiv-male.
Ai._comment_AnalysisRepair: Analysis-output repair layer (analysis-output-repair plan, p6-config). Governs BOTH repair stages in UnifiedAnalysisService.ApplyAnalysisRepairAsync AND the whole-book review ENGINE-path glossary hook in BookReviewService (f5-wire). THREE states: (1) Enabled=false -> FULL no-op (neither the deterministic glossary nor the LLM pass runs). (2) Enabled=true + GuardOnly=true -> deterministic glossary ONLY, no LLM (the SHIPPED DEFAULT below, per the p3-gate GUARD-ONLY decision: the glossary is deterministic+fail-safe+validated, while the value-scoped LLM showed an over-rewrite tendency on mixed leak+prose fields, so it stays opt-in). (3) Enabled=true + GuardOnly=false -> glossary + value-scoped LLM repair (guard-gated+fail-safe inside the service; a clean field makes ZERO model calls). PerType gates repair per AnalysisType name (Summarization/LiteraryAnalysis/LinguisticAnalysis/LineEdit, plus the f5-wire book-level structured-Hebrew-prose types BookOverview/CharacterAnalysis/StoryAnalysis/QA and the whole-book BookReview engine hook; a type absent/false is skipped; Proofread is NEVER repaired regardless). BookReview is glossary-only (deterministic, no LLM) regardless of GuardOnly. KEEP IN SYNC with AiOptions.AnalysisRepairOptions; Model MUST match Ai:FeatureModels:AnalysisRepair (and Ai:ProviderSettings:Ollama_AnalysisRepair) - those keys do the routing, this Model documents the intended repair model.
